subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship only copy/select for ordinary message text first, or should the first message-action surface also include Share and Reply?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the UX gap, but the proposed long-press menu expands Android chat interaction beyond a strict existing-contract bug fix.

options.title: Ship copy/select first
options.body: Implement full-message Copy plus selective text selection in the Android chat bubble and leave Share and Reply for separate follow-up.

options.title: Ship full action sheet
options.body: Approve the broader long-press menu with Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply if maintainers want Android to match a richer messaging-app pattern now.

options.title: Defer action surface
options.body: Keep this as accepted Android UX friction but do not add a new message action surface until broader mobile chat priorities are set.

recommendation.title: Ship copy/select first
recommendation.body: Implement full-message Copy plus selective text selection in the Android chat bubble and leave Share and Reply for separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and the remaining blocker is product scope rather than hidden renderer ownership.
